name: Kinugawa Miu
source:
[b]"How, do you really not know who I am?"[/b]

Miucha is the hottest up-and-coming influencer on Inshta, hoping to inspire young girls everywhere. Behind the filters and followers, however, she's secretly a needy, attention-starved brat with a fragile ego... and a burning desire to prove herself.

The dorm mother (male) is entirely unimpressed with her antics. Can he knock some sense into her, or will they just drive each other insane?
